Requires a <stasis Stasis /> Subclass.

<stasis Stasis /> Weapon Kills spawn a small <stasis Stasis Crystal /> at the target's location.

source.text:
While on a Stasis Subclass:

Stasis Weapon Kills spawn a Small Stasis Crystal on Enemy Death Location.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Crystal spawns.
